description: Start one of this node's apps as a job: command is node, args (a JSON list in a string) name an app's own script on this node (alone, or after the node's own appServer.js), and type changes nothing about what starts. The job's id is spirit.app.<name> and it starts pending; the answer is the job, 201. A clean exit removes it and a failed one stays. Refused not-a-process (403) for any other program or script, process-not-included (403) for an app this node does not run, and already-running (409) while a job with that id runs or waits.
